extracted.subtask_description: Concise prescriptive rules for plain English usage and composition that aim to produce clear, direct prose; covers punctuation, grammar, paragraph and sentence-level composition, word choice, and matters of form. Intended as a practical reference for writers learning or teaching composition.

rubrics_metrics.name: Make definite assertions
rubrics_metrics.description: Make definite assertions. Avoid tame, colorless, hesitating, non-committal language.—Rule 12

rubrics_metrics.name: Form the possessive singular of nouns with ’s
rubrics_metrics.description: Form the possessive singular of nouns with ’s

rubrics_metrics.name: Use a comma in a series (Oxford comma)
rubrics_metrics.description: In a series of three or more terms with a single conjunction, use a comma after each term except the last

rubrics_metrics.name: Enclose parenthetic expressions between commas
rubrics_metrics.description: Enclose parenthetic expressions between commas

rubrics_metrics.name: Place a comma before conjunctions introducing independent clauses
rubrics_metrics.description: Place a comma before and or but introducing an independent clause

rubrics_metrics.name: Do not join independent clauses by a comma
rubrics_metrics.description: Do not join independent clauses by a comma

rubrics_metrics.name: Do not break sentences in two
rubrics_metrics.description: Do not break sentences in two

rubrics_metrics.name: Participial phrase must refer to grammatical subject
rubrics_metrics.description: A participial phrase at the beginning of a sentence must refer to the grammatical subject

rubrics_metrics.name: Divide words at line-ends correctly
rubrics_metrics.description: Divide words at line-ends, in accordance with their formation and pronunciation

rubrics_metrics.name: Make the paragraph the unit of composition
rubrics_metrics.description: Make the paragraph the unit of composition: one paragraph to each topic

rubrics_metrics.name: Begin paragraphs with a topic sentence
rubrics_metrics.description: As a rule, begin each paragraph with a topic sentence; end it in conformity with the beginning

rubrics_metrics.name: Use the active voice
rubrics_metrics.description: Use the active voice

rubrics_metrics.name: Put statements in positive form
rubrics_metrics.description: Put statements in positive form

rubrics_metrics.name: Omit needless words
rubrics_metrics.description: Omit needless words

rubrics_metrics.name: Avoid a succession of loose sentences
rubrics_metrics.description: Avoid a succession of loose sentences

rubrics_metrics.name: Express coordinate ideas in similar form
rubrics_metrics.description: Express co-ordinate ideas in similar form

rubrics_metrics.name: Keep related words together
rubrics_metrics.description: Keep related words together

rubrics_metrics.name: Keep one tense in summaries
rubrics_metrics.description: In summaries, keep to one tense

rubrics_metrics.name: Place emphatic words at sentence end
rubrics_metrics.description: Place the emphatic words of a sentence at the end
